title: Max Endurance AMRAP
description: 10-minute AMRAP with sumo squats, wide push-ups, alternating lunges and sit-ups to push your endurance limits

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Lateral shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral movements, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide apart, toes pointing outward

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate forward left and forward right without pausing

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, sit all the way up, touch your feet

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
